liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- The performance marked the first time this specific track was played by the band [1]
- The song included teases and quotes from the track Perihelion during its performance [1]
- The printed setlist identified this song with the alternate title Frankenstein [1]
- The setlist named it Couple 22-Beers, and lyrics changed to mention dancing [1]

## The recordings

- **kglw2025-11-15.SBD** (recommended): soundboard; 0 songs; 147 min [1]

## Around the show

- Ambrose performed the verses from the mosh pit, referencing specific rock songs [1]

## Tapers and lineage

- **kglw2025-11-15.SBD**: taped by Sam Joseph, Joseph Santarpia, Gaspard De Meulemeester, Grace Reader and Brandon DeLapp; source: SBD [1]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Blaxteeco: [King Gizzard And The Lizard Wizard Gothenburg Sweden 2025 Event Poster At Filmstudion On November 15 2025 Home Decor Pos](https://blaxteeco.com/product/king-gizzard-and-the-lizard-wizard-gothenburg-sweden-2025-event-poster-at-filmstudion-on-november-15-2025-home-decor-poster-canvas/) [3]
- Poster by Blaxteeco: [King Gizzard And The Lizard Wizard Gothenburg Sweden 2025 Event Poster At Filmstudion On November 15 2025 T-Shirt - Blax](https://blaxteeco.com/product/king-gizzard-and-the-lizard-wizard-gothenburg-sweden-2025-event-poster-at-filmstudion-on-november-15-2025-t-shirt/) [4]
